name: concat_cast_kv_fp8_pad
description: Fused non-prefix Q8KV8 KV preparation for DSA sparse prefill. Concatenate the bf16 NoPE latent k [num_tokens, NOPE] and the bf16 rope segment k_rope [num_tokens, ROPE] along the last dimension, cast them to float8_e4m3fn, and write them into out[row, 0:NOPE] and out[row, NOPE:NOPE+ROPE] for rows [0, num_tokens). Rows [num_tokens, total_rows) are the pad band and are filled with zero bytes; they must be zero because the sparse-attention index clamp maps a -1 sentinel onto the last row, so those rows are read. Replaces a bf16 torch.cat materialization, a separate cast-copy and a separate tail clear with one row-per-program launch. ROPE may be 0 for NoPE models, in which case only the NoPE segment is written. out must be float8_e4m3fn with width NOPE + ROPE. Returns out.
